notes: Finalized and exposed all seven firearm manufacturer passives on the player-facing weapon cards.

Bastion ACTION SURGE is now kill-triggered instead of once per Long Rest: once per turn, a Bastion firearm kill grants one extra Action that can only attack with a Bastion firearm; the surge cannot retrigger that turn.
Kurohane DEAD SILENT makes its firearms completely inaudible; Corvus RAM THIEF drains remaining cyberdeck RAM on a Corvus kill.
ForgeLine ANCHOR grants Advantage only on turns with no movement; Helix SELF-CHARGING CELL fully restores the wielded weapon after a turn in which it was not fired.
Jade Arc ARC CHAIN deals full normal weapon damage to one other enemy within 5 feet of a killed target and cannot recursively chain.
Vektor CUNNING ACTION grants Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a Bonus Action while wielding a Vektor firearm.
Reran Bastion ratings for the stronger kill-triggered surge; Warwake rises to 83, Tactician to 70, Umbra to 69, and pricing/shop bands follow the updated ratings.
Melee remains unchanged pending a deliberate decision on whether to add any universal or family passives.
